units.source_text: 这西殿是平常不用的屋子，所以设备不周。

en.t: This western wing was a room not ordinarily used, so its furnishings were incomplete.

units.source_text: 源氏公子便命惟光叫人取帐幕和屏风来，布置一番。

en.t: Prince Genji therefore ordered Koremitsu to have people bring curtains and screens and arrange the room.

units.source_text: 只要把帷屏的垂布放下，铺好席位，把应用器什安置妥帖，便可居住。

en.t: Once the hanging curtains of the screens were lowered, the mats laid out, and the necessary utensils properly set in place, it would be fit to stay in.

units.source_text: 再命把东殿的被褥取来，准备就寝。

en.t: He further ordered bedding to be brought from the eastern wing and prepared for sleep.

units.source_text: 紫儿心中十分恐惧，四肢发抖，不知源氏公子要拿自己怎么样。

en.t: Murasaki was terribly frightened inside, her limbs trembling, not knowing what Prince Genji meant to do with her.

units.source_text: 总算不曾放声啼哭，只是说：“我要跟少纳言妈妈睡！”

en.t: At least she did not burst out crying, but only said, “I want to sleep with Mama Shonagon!”
Her manner was truly just like that of a little child.

units.source_text: 源氏公子便开导她：“今后不该再跟乳母睡了。”

en.t: Prince Genji then gently admonished her, “From now on, you must not sleep with your nurse anymore.”

units.source_text: 紫儿伤心得很，啼啼哭哭地睡了。

en.t: Murasaki was deeply hurt and fell asleep sobbing.

units.source_text: 少纳言乳母睡也睡不着，只是茫茫然地淌眼泪。

en.t: Nurse Shonagon could not sleep either, and merely shed tears in a daze.

units.source_text: 她环视四周，但见宫殿的构造和装饰无限富丽，

en.t: She looked around and saw that the palace architecture and decorations were splendid beyond measure,

units.source_text: 连庭中的铺石都像宝玉一般，使得她目眩神移。

en.t: and even the paving stones in the garden seemed like jewels, leaving her dazzled and entranced.

units.source_text: 她身上服饰简朴，自惭形秽，幸而这里没有侍女。

en.t: Her own clothing was plain, making her ashamed of her appearance, but fortunately there were no ladies-in-waiting there.

units.source_text: 这西殿原是偶尔招待不大亲近的客人住宿用的，只有几个男仆站在帘外伺候。

en.t: This western wing had originally been used only occasionally to lodge guests who were not especially intimate, and only a few male servants stood waiting outside the blinds.

units.source_text: 他们窥知昨夜迎接女客来此住宿，相与悄悄地谈论：

en.t: They had guessed that a female guest had been brought there to spend the night, and quietly discussed it among themselves:

units.source_text: “不知来的是何等样人？一定是特别宠爱的了。”

en.t: “I wonder what sort of person has come here. She must be someone especially favored.”
